model_contract.field: At each frozen vertex, (absolute_target_z - measured_baseline_z) times the product of the two axis tapers; fixed linear interpolation inside each triangle.
model_contract.quantities: Clip each linear triangle at zero; integrate negative and positive lobes separately; use the configured in-situ density and round once to integer grams per lobe.
model_contract.projection: One independent global cut fraction times min(field,0), plus one global fill fraction times max(field,0). The frozen baseline is not projected again.
model_contract.progress_limit: Distributed whole-field progress per phase; no spatially advancing bucket simulation.
model_contract.funding: Start requires capacity for the complete cut and actual existing stock covering max(fill-cut,0). No cut is credited before real warehouse unloading.
model_contract.phase_transition: Fill reservation and delivery begin only after all actual cut has been deposited and its truck/buffer have drained.
model_contract.zero_gram_rule: A true zero field is valid; nonzero signed lobes that round to zero grams are rejected.

overlapping_history_example.description: Opposite 0.75m hats offset southwest/northeast; the combined field is clipped before computing cut/fill.

model_contract.physical_limit: Exact grams refer to this fixed triangle model, not an independent survey of the quantized ShaderWorld terrain mesh.

baseline_acceptance.scope: Bounded local sampled-height acceptance; terrain between tested points is not guaranteed.

model_contract.reference_reconstruction: Freeze actual measured heights and a separate reference after subtracting already executed queue deltas. Restore/inter-step checks interpolate a containing reference raster and add executed projections once.

gpu_projection_contract.transient_vertex_texture: PF_R32_FLOAT; non-sRGB, no streaming, nearest filter and clamp addressing
gpu_projection_contract.interpolation: Explicit four vertex loads and the same fixed 00-to-11 triangle interpolation as CPU; no hardware bilinear field.
gpu_projection_contract.cut_fill_combination: Clamp the interpolated signed field to its negative/positive lobe before multiplying the independent progress fractions.
gpu_projection_contract.physical_scope: Own material v2 with exact 50 cm lab collision passed full uncooked and fresh Development cooked create/resume pairs. Normal demo autoload/model and agent-reviewed Slate pixels passed separately. No arbitrary-shape, continuous-surface, performance, human or physical-input proof.
gpu_projection_contract.raster_side_source: Texture dimensions reported by Deltas.GetDimensions; width must equal height. Grid.x/y/z carry only raster origin and spacing. Grid.w is not used.

physical_collision_contract.property_meaning: CollisionResolution is spacing between physical collision vertices in centimetres.
physical_collision_contract.legacy_lower_raise: Existing 100 cm Lower/Raise remains allowed; the new exact-spacing requirement is operation-specific.
physical_collision_contract.setup_scope: Only marked owned EarthworksLab, exactly one collision terrain, previous spacing 50 or 100, preserved original metadata, saved level and reload readback. Other maps and plugin files remain unchanged.
physical_collision_contract.cost_limit: 50 cm produces approximately four times as many area samples as 100 cm at comparable coverage; no measured frame-rate or large-world claim.
physical_collision_contract.reproduction_limit: The original 100 cm physical mesh could bridge the sign crease between clipped vertex heights even when CPU and GPU displacement formulas agree. 50 cm is the bounded lab profile; it does not prove all intermediate points or all mixed shapes.
